text:
Eight days left to win up to ₹3 lakh for a voice-AI prototype built on Gemini.

YourStory has launched "Build with Gemini – Shape What's Next", a national voice-AI hackathon run with Google Cloud India and Hack2skill. Builders pitch an idea for a voice-first product, and shortlisted teams go on to prototype it using Gemini.

The prize pool is ₹8 lakh. The winner takes ₹3 lakh, the first runner-up ₹2 lakh and the second runner-up ₹1.25 lakh, while five more teams receive ₹35,000 each. Every shortlisted team also gets US$100 in Google Cloud credits, plus visibility through YourStory's coverage.

It is open to working professionals such as developers, AI/ML engineers, data scientists and technical founders, entering alone or in teams of up to four. Registration and idea submission are the first gate for shortlisting.

The catch many people miss: this edition excludes students, so a team with even one student member is a risk. And since no closing time has been announced, aim to submit by the end of 2 December IST rather than leaving it to the final day.

text:
Did you know a Rajasthan startup can get a grant of up to ₹60 lakh, with no equity, and no deadline to chase?

The Seed-Stage Viability Grant is run by iStart Rajasthan, the state's startup platform under the Department of Information Technology & Communication. The size of the grant depends on your iStart QRate score: non-rated registered startups can receive ₹10 lakh, the Bronze bands unlock ₹20, ₹30 or ₹40 lakh, and startups rated Silver or above qualify for ₹60 lakh.

To apply, you need to be a seed-stage startup registered in or operating from Rajasthan and registered on the iStart platform. Non-rated startups go through a committee evaluation, and the state can notify further criteria.

The practical tip founders often miss is the upgrade bonus. If you improve your QRate score within the allowed window, three months for Bronze and eighteen months for Silver and above, you can claim the difference for the higher slab. So it is worth getting assessed early and working on your rating. The scheme comes from the 2022 state policy, so confirm on the portal that it is still in force before you start.

text:
Won a Kerala government order but short on working capital? KSUM will lend women-led startups up to ₹15 lakh at just 6% simple interest.

The Soft Loan Scheme for Women Entrepreneurs is run by Kerala Startup Mission, the Government of Kerala's startup agency. It funds up to 80% of the value of a confirmed purchase or work order from a Kerala government department or public sector undertaking, with a maximum outstanding of ₹15 lakh. The money is released in step with milestones certified by the client, and you give up no equity.

To qualify, your startup must be women-led, registered in Kerala as a private limited company or LLP, hold an active KSUM Unique ID and DPIIT recognition, and be building an innovative product or technology. Pure service and trading firms are generally excluded, and you must have no outstanding dues to KSUM or any government agency.

One catch to plan for: the loan must be repaid within one year or on project completion, whichever comes first. Also file Form INC-22A so your MCA status shows "Active", because the money is not released without it. A director CIBIL score above 750 is preferred.
